summary: No AEMO meteorological forecast product for Adelaide was returned by the retrieved evidence set; the retrieved AEMO procedure lists Adelaide Airport and other sites as the South Australia weather reference locations [c1].

The latest forecast run provably public by 2026-07-30T06:00:00Z (run_id PUBLIC_FORECAST_OPERATIONAL_DEMAND_HH_202607301330_20260730130206) gives POE50 = 1508.0 MW for the interval ending 2026-07-30T17:00:00Z (2026-07-31 02:30 ACST) [ev0538].

Other POE50 values from the same provably‑public run include POE50 = 1584.0 MW for 2026-07-30T16:00:00Z [ev0532], POE50 = 1545.0 MW for 2026-07-30T16:30:00Z [ev0535], POE50 = 2073.0 MW for 2026-07-30T22:30:00Z [ev0571], and POE50 = 2014.0 MW for 2026-07-30T23:00:00Z [ev0574].

A compare forecast→actual could not be produced as of 2026-07-30T06:00:00Z because actual operational demand rows for the target half‑hours were not provably public by that as_of time (actuals unavailable) (see missing_evidence and uncertainties).
